descriptionByLocale.it:
A STRABAG, circa 89.000 persone stanno facendo progressi in oltre 2.400 sedi in tutto il mondo. L'unicità e i punti di forza individuali caratterizzano non solo i nostri progetti, ma anche ognuno di noi. Sia nella costruzione che nell'ingegneria, nell'ingegneria stradale e civile, nella costruzione di ponti e gallerie, nella produzione di materiali da costruzione, nello sviluppo di progetti o nella gestione degli edifici, stiamo pensando di diventare il più innovativo e sostenibile gruppo di tecnologie per l'edilizia in Europa. Pari opportunità, diversità e inclusione sono parte integrante di ciò che ci rende una società e come lavoriamo. Insieme implementiamo i progetti con successo e in partnership e cresciamo in nuovi compiti. Insieme creiamo grandi cose. Facciamo progressi! • Gestione auto-responsabile dei debitori e dei conti pagabili, compresa la manutenzione operativa continua per le nostre società di Gruppo e gruppi di lavoro

descriptionByLocale.en:
At STRABAG, around 89,000 people are making progress at more than 2,400 locations worldwide. Uniqueness and individual strengths characterize not only our projects, but also each and every one of us. Whether in building and engineering, road and civil engineering, bridge and tunnel construction, building materials production, project development or building management - we are thinking ahead to become the most innovative and sustainable construction technology group in Europe. Equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion are integral parts of what makes us a company and how we work. Together we implement projects successfully and in partnership and grow in new tasks. Together we create great things. Let's make progress! Personnel:in debtors / creditors Your contribution with us
• Self-responsible management of debtors and accounts payable including continuous operating maintenance for our Group companies and working groups
• Examination and release of decentralised creditor bills and reconciliation of daily bank statements
• Timely execution of weekly payments
• Monitoring and compliance with internal compliance requirements
• Central contact point for questions of the group companies and working groups under management What matters to us
• Commercial basic education (EFZ) or Matura, ideally supplemented by a degree as a clerk:in accounting or a similar further education
• Relevant accounting experience
• In-depth knowledge of Swiss Obligation Law (OR) and Swiss VAT Law
• Analytical thinking combined with a high level of initiative and a structured, exact and goal-oriented working method
• High reliability as well as a helpful and service-oriented attitude towards internal and external partners
• Secure handling of MS Office applications Our added value for you
• Diverse training opportunities
• Parking
• Free drinks
• Sports activities
• Competitive remuneration
• Staff discounts
• Reconciliation of family and professional life
• Health promotion
• Staff events
• Good transport connections Contact details Rexhep Elmazi Bicategory 4 6472 First field +41 41 882 11 11 Apply now
